title.narrative: ''Egypt Innovation Ecosystem Accelerator through Agile, Smart and Integrated innovation resource portal (ECOSYS+)

description.narrative: The ECOSYS+ aims to reinforce the national innovation ecosystem, upscaling its presence & strength on global scale with interactive dynamic tools to build targeted innovative products & services while providing support in the form of investment, incubation, acceleration, partnerships for testing of prototypes and commercial systems, targeting human resources and access to key infrastructures. ECOSYS+ brings a very innovative implementation path in addressing this aspect, first of all by considering the interactions between all innovation actors from a circular economy perspective, and by involving the widest possible range of stakeholders through the Quintuple Helix. The quintuple helix will allow to take into consideration all the key elements for triggering innovation process as well as to unlock growth policies towards the concepts of open and responsible innovation for a step-change in local economy and society. The goal of the Helix-Conception is augmented through the resource of knowledge which produces additional value for society in order to lead in the field of sustainable development and at the same time collecting inputs from the society via the ECOSYS+ channels. ECOSYS approach has already the required political support and commitment which will allow to scale fast and ensure its sustainability Among other previous activities of ECOSYS+ members, the project starts from past and ongoing initiatives. The portal-related expertise paved the ground to facilitate the implementation. Linkages and synergy with other relevant portals are greatly foreseen from the initial phase including linkage to Egypt SMEs agency, crowdfunding platforms and other authorities. The online approach of ECOSYS+ is complemented with real-life knowledge-sharing and brokerage events. The central web-portal is an interactive interface with social networking tools, augmented with mobile application.
